title: Can I BEAT ChatGPT in Chess?
summary: Tony plays ChatGPT through a chat window, mirroring moves on a board. Rule: whatever ChatGPT says it plays becomes reality (even illegal moves), while Tony must obey standard chess rules; a real checkmate on the board ends the game regardless of what ChatGPT claims. ChatGPT narrates every move with chatty commentary ('classic positional', 'keeping it mysterious'), eventually hallucinates (illegal moves, claims a queen can't reach a square) and even 'corrects' Tony's mate. Tony still wins.
rules: Bot (ChatGPT) moves are accepted as written even if illegal (pieces jumping, impossible captures, wrong-square moves, resurrected pieces).
A genuine checkmate on the board ends the game, even if the bot disputes it.
